## Review checklist
- [ ] This change follows the approved MediLink scope and frontend conventions.
- [ ] I checked responsive layouts and accessibility for affected screens.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private API keys, or real patient data.
- [ ] I updated documentation or tests where needed.
- [ ] Any new dependency is agreed by the team and `package.json` and `package-lock.json` are updated together.
